data.title: Ships through the gallery window

memoryNodes.cue: Lin leaves her coat before going upstairs.
A working ship and a holiday ship occupy different parts of the harbour.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 货运船与度假船位于港湾不同位置。

memoryNodes.cue: Visitors compare sea and land journeys.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 访客比较海路与陆路旅程。

data.situation:
Across the river, a small travel gallery stood above the harbour. Lin left her coat in the cloakroom and went upstairs. A cargo vessel lay beyond the window; farther out, a cruise ship was preparing to leave. A display compared its luxurious cabins with the much smaller space on an early research boat. Maya stopped beside a map marked with a route into the Antarctic. A research journey
The expedition took researchers along the coast, where they collected observations. The navigator kept a record of positions and changes of course. Weather delayed several landings, and the crew sometimes had to wait aboard. Photographs and diary pages are shown in the next case. Maya: This route crosses a whole continent.
Lin: That’s an overland journey, rather than a sea route.
Maya: Imagine carrying everything you need.
Lin: I’d start with something smaller. But I want to know why they chose that route.

readingBlocks.en: Across the river, a small travel gallery stood above the harbour. Lin left her coat in the cloakroom and went upstairs. A cargo vessel lay beyond the window; farther out, a cruise ship was preparing to leave. A display compared its luxurious cabins with the much smaller space on an early research boat. Maya stopped beside a map marked with a route into the Antarctic.
readingBlocks.zh: 河对岸，一座小旅行展厅位于港湾上方。林把外套留在衣帽间，走上楼。窗外停着一艘货船，更远处，一艘邮轮正准备离开。展板把邮轮的豪华舱房与一艘早期研究船小得多的空间作比较。玛雅在一张标有南极路线的地图旁停下。

readingBlocks.en:
A research journey
The expedition took researchers along the coast, where they collected observations. The navigator kept a record of positions and changes of course. Weather delayed several landings, and the crew sometimes had to wait aboard. Photographs and diary pages are shown in the next case.
readingBlocks.zh:
一次研究之旅
这次考察带研究人员沿海岸行进，收集观测资料。领航员记录位置与航向变化。天气延误了几次登岸，船员有时必须在船上等候。照片与日记页陈列在下一处展柜。
readingBlocks.title: Beside the Antarctic map

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: This route crosses a whole continent.
Lin: That’s an overland journey, rather than a sea route.
Maya: Imagine carrying everything you need.
Lin: I’d start with something smaller. But I want to know why they chose that route.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：这条路线横穿整片大陆。
林：那是陆路旅程，不是海上路线。
玛雅：想想带着所有必需品行走。
林：我会先从小一点的旅程开始。不过我想知道他们为什么选这条路。

glossary.zh: 载游客进行度假旅行的大型船；邮轮
glossary.note: 整块是船舶名称；cruise作动词表示巡航等用法不同。
glossary.example: A cruise ship is preparing to leave the harbour.

externalEvidence.definition: a passenger ship used commercially for pleasure cruises

glossary.note: 可数名词，此处船舶；容器与血管义另有对象。
glossary.example: A cargo vessel lies beyond the window.

externalEvidence.definition: a craft designed for water transportation

glossary.zh: 非常舒适且昂贵的；豪华的
glossary.note: luxurious修饰住宿、设施等；表示奢华舒适。
glossary.example: The display shows the ship’s luxurious cabins.
glossary.exampleZh: 展板展示船上的豪华舱房。

externalEvidence.definition: displaying luxury and furnishing gratification to the senses

glossary.zh: 存放外套或包的房间；衣帽间
glossary.note: 本句存放衣物的房间；英式委婉指洗手间的用法另看语境。
glossary.example: Lin leaves her coat in the cloakroom.

externalEvidence.definition: a room where coats and other articles can be left temporarily

glossary.zh: 为特定考察或探索目的组织的旅程；考察
glossary.note: 可数名词，a scientific expedition；本句是研究人员有组织的考察旅程。
glossary.example: A scientific expedition took the researchers along the coast.
glossary.exampleZh: 一次科学考察带研究人员沿海岸行进。

externalEvidence.definition: a journey organized for a particular purpose

glossary.zh: 确定船舶等位置与航向的领航员
glossary.note: 可数人物名词；本句船上负责位置和航向的人员，不是手机软件。
glossary.example: The navigator records the ship’s position.

externalEvidence.definition: the ship's officer in charge of navigation

glossary.note: 本句形容词修饰journey；也可作副词，如travel overland。
glossary.example: The map shows an overland journey across the continent.
glossary.exampleZh: 地图显示一段横穿大陆的陆路旅程。
